scope: Complete official evaluation splits, not sampled subsets

hotpot.name: HotpotQA
hotpot.metric: Answer EM/F1, EOS completion diagnostics; no support labels used by repair

mmlu.name: MMLU
mmlu.metric: Primary: same-prefill ABCD option-logprob accuracy; micro and subject-macro. Generated-letter/EOS correctness is secondary.

gsm8k.name: GSM8K
gsm8k.metric: Decimal numeric equality on final #### NUMBER line; no EOS gate

method: Same checkpoint, original input questions, native chat template, greedy decoding, no truncation or output-based exclusion. QA max32 new tokens; GSM8K max512 new tokens.
reference: Full-test capability-preservation convention follows Tracing the Persona Circuit AppendixB.1; task-specific prompting is defined explicitly here, not claimed identical to that paper.
